entries.en: A client wishes to free another man of his earthly possessions. More specifically, need you to swipe Kerry Eurodyne's guitar.
entries.ro: Un client vrea să-i ia unui alt bărbat tot ce are. Mai exact, trebuie să furi chitara lui Kerry Eurodyne.

entries.en: The job is simple, the reward high. More intel attached. I'll be waiting.
entries.ro: Treaba e simplă, plata e mare. Mai multe detalii atașate. Te aștept.
